const r = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  subject: `✅ Pearcedale Forecast PASSED — ${r.total_skus} SKUs — ${r.run_date}`,
  body: [
    `Forecast run completed successfully.`,
    ``,
    `Run ID: ${r.run_id}`,
    `As-of date: ${r.run_date}`,
    `Horizon: ${r.horizon?.start} to ${r.horizon?.end}`,
    `Total SKUs: ${r.total_skus}`,
    `Active promotions: ${r.skus_with_active_promotion}`,
    `Total forecast quantity: ${Math.round(r.total_forecast_quantity)} units`,
    ``,
    `PO Decisions:`,
    `  CREATE PO: ${r.po_decisions?.CREATE_PO || 0}`,
    `  REVIEW REQUIRED: ${r.po_decisions?.REVIEW_REQUIRED || 0}`,
    `  NO PO REQUIRED: ${r.po_decisions?.NO_PO_REQUIRED || 0}`,
    ``,
    `Critical stockout risk: ${r.critical_stockout_risk_skus || 0} SKUs`,
    ``,
    `⚠️ Inventory is simulated. Do not place real POs from this test.`,
  ].join('\n'),
  full_result: r
}}];

const r = $input.first().json;
const stage = r.failure_stage || 'unknown';
const errors = (r.errors || ['Unknown error']).join('\n  • ');
return [{ json: {
  subject: `🚨 Pearcedale Forecast FAILED — ${stage} — ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
  body: [
    `The daily forecast pipeline failed at stage: ${stage}`,
    ``,
    `Errors:`,
    `  • ${errors}`,
    ``,
    r.run_id ? `Run ID: ${r.run_id}` : 'No run ID (request may not have reached the model)',
    `Timestamp: ${r.timestamp || new Date().toISOString()}`,
    ``,
    `Troubleshooting:`,
    stage === 'http_request' ? `  → Check that the Modal app is deployed and the URL/token are correct.`
      : stage === 'model_execution' ? `  → Check Modal logs: modal app logs pearcedale-forecast`
      : `  → Inspect the validation errors above. The model produced output but it failed checks.`,
    ``,
    `The n8n workflow will retry automatically at the next scheduled time.`,
    `To retry now, trigger the workflow manually.`,
  ].join('\n'),
  full_result: r
}}];

parameters.content:
## Pearcedale Modal Forecast Pipeline

**Schedule:** Daily at 6:00 AM (configurable)

**Setup required:**
1. Set `MODAL_FORECAST_URL` in n8n Variables
2. Set `MODAL_FORECAST_TOKEN` in n8n Variables
3. Connect the success/failure outputs to your preferred notification (Email, Slack, etc.)

**Failure handling:**
- HTTP errors → caught by onError → formatted alert
- Model errors → Modal returns status:error → formatted alert
- Validation errors → 13 checks run → formatted alert

All three paths produce a structured alert with troubleshooting guidance.
